correctness.rationale: Each maximum 2 separates binary input blocks; the hare recursion concatenates their sorted images and appends all twos. Conversely every descent 10 needs a separator in such a factorization, and cutting exactly at the descents and padding by empty blocks realizes any permitted prefix, also when the prefix is empty or c=0. The positive internal runs and optional endpoint runs give precisely binom(a,j) binom(b,j) prefixes with j descents. The maximum j=min(a,b) is realized by alternating, so the cutoff is necessary and sufficient. A deterministic debt counter with finite-state memory of the last symbol accepts at zero debt in a terminal-two phase (or zero at the end of the binary prefix); the prefixes (10)^j have pairwise distinct right quotients. Summing the three binomial-geometric series gives the stated rational functions. The cubic g(t)=1-2t+t^2-t^3 has one simple real root r in (0,1); its conjugate roots have modulus sqrt(1/r), and the additional pole at 1 is farther away. The simple-pole coefficient is -1/[r(1-r)g'(r)], agreeing with the frozen K and lambda. The independent ascending-input stack simulation (pop strictly smaller top, push on equality) exhausted lengths 0–10 and matched all support sets and Parikh counts. All-length and nonregularity assertions are proved, not extrapolated from that run.

evidence: The same Resultary record ending 6c21b2d55722 has the identical d10 condition. The distinct ternary tortoise record ending e29424595bbe instead gives a regular image language.
Hare pushes a symbol on a stack top of the same value; tortoise does not. For example hare(221)=122 whereas tortoise(221)=212.
equivalent_formulations.reasoning: A test of positive hare fertility or membership in the one-pass hare image is equivalent. Calling tortoise a word stack-sort does not make its output support or automaton class equivalent. Likewise, counting classes among subwords of a fixed infinite sequence restricts the input rather than exhausts the three-letter image.

value.rationale: The first nonbinary alphabet is the first case where ordinary sorting ceases to explain the hare output space. The characterization gives a useful comparison at exactly the alphabet size where tortoise still has regular image support. It pinpoints one unbounded arithmetic obstruction while giving a sharp threshold at each content and a rational growth law despite nonregularity; this is more useful than merely re-evaluating individual fertilities.
residual_risks: No extension to higher alphabets or iteration, and no claim to classify all preimage multiplicities.
